name: Azofix Plus
shortDescription: Plant microbial biostimulant for more efficient fixation of atmospheric nitrogen — its bacteria fix nitrogen in a form accessible to the plant and promote the biological activity of soils.
descriptionHtml:
Azofix Plus is a plant microbial biostimulant built around the nitrogen-fixing bacterium Paenibacillus polymyxa MVY-024, enriched with B-group vitamins and microelements. Its bacteria fix atmospheric nitrogen in a form that is accessible to the plant and promote the biological activity of soils — feeding the crop by first feeding the soil.

Registered with Ecocert and FiBL and approved for organic farming, it is applied to the soil from before sowing up to the crop covering the ground, at 1–5 L/ha depending on the crop.

instructionsHtml:
Application requirements

  • Spray on the soil before sowing, or until the plants no longer leave the soil surface uncovered. In other cases, consult a Humuson sales representative.
  • Sprayer pressure 1–10 bar (15–145 psi); nozzle size at least 50 µm.
  • Can be mixed with all kinds of fertilisers and pesticides unless their manufacturer states otherwise. May contain natural sediments.

Storage & safety

  • Avoid storage above 30 °C. Once opened, use Azofix Plus as soon as possible — or refrigerate at 4 °C and use within 72 hours.
  • Non-toxic, with no irritating compounds; no risk to humans, animals or the environment. Rinse with running water after skin or eye contact.

Manufactured by Bioenergy LT, Panevėžys, Lithuania. Laboratory quality certificate; approved for organic farming.

name: Maxprolin
shortDescription: Improves plant response to cold weather, frost, waterlogging or drought by increasing the concentration of proline in plants.
descriptionHtml:
Maxprolin is pure L-proline — the amino acid plants accumulate when they face stress. Applied before or during stress periods it helps the crop reduce biotic and abiotic stress, regulates the uptake of micro- and macro-elements and stimulates the plant's natural defence mechanisms.

Purpose translated from the manufacturer's label (Bioenergy LT, Lithuania).

Why Maxprolin?

  • Improves plant response to cold weather, frost, waterlogging, or drought;
  • Promotes seed germination, root hairs formation regulates water circulation in the plant;
  • Promotes the formation of chlorophyll b in plants, increases the photosynthesis process;
  • Increases sugar accumulation in cells and intercellular transport processes, therefore better response to winter conditions;
  • Increases yield and crop quality.

Operating principle:

Proline is accumulated in cells of plants under unfavorable plant growth conditions. The experimental data let us draw the conclusion that the accumulation of proline in plants has a protective function. The application of MaxProlin increases the concentration of proline in plants. It is scientifically proved that proline metabolism affects plant response to stress (cold, heat, drought): the plant growth is optimized and resistance to adverse environmental factors is increased.

Additional Information: Click Me

shortDescription: Basal dressing containing humic and fulvic acids, amino acids and phytohormones — prevents nitrogen leaching, stabilizes phosphorus and increases nutrient availability and absorption.
descriptionHtml:

BIOSTIMULANT PROPERTIES — NUTRITIONAL COMPONENTS

  • Contains 17 essential amino acids
  • Phytohormones (Auxins and cytokinins)
  • Chelating agents (Amino acids, fulvic acid and humic acids)
  • Micro and Macro Nutrients
  • Makroelements: organic NPK
  • organic carbon (humified carbon and watersoluble carbon)
  • rich with natural vitamins: contains carotene (provitamin A), B1 B2 B3 B5 B6 B12 E, C, D, P)
  • organic acids: folic acid, humic acids fulvic acid
  • trace elements (Mn, Cu, B, Zn, I, Br, Mo, V, Cr, Be, Ni, Ag, Sn, Pb As, Ba, Sr, Ti)
  • amino acids (Glutamic acid, Glycine, Valine, Arginine, Aspartic acid, Alanine, Serine, Leucine, Isoleucine, Phenylalanine, Tyrosine, Lysine, Methionine, Threonine, Cystine)
  • contains enzymes ( peroxidase, reductase, protease)
  • glycoprotein, glomalin
  • phytohormones (auxin and cytokinin)

Humic acids

Here are some potential advantages of using humic acids for seed soaking:

  1. Enhanced seed germination: Humic acids can help stimulate seed germination by breaking seed dormancy and promoting the activation of enzymes involved in germination processes. Soaking seeds in humic acids can potentially result in faster and more uniform germination rates.
  2. Improved nutrient availability: Humic acids have the ability to chelate or bind with essential nutrients, such as iron, zinc, and manganese, making them more available for plant uptake. By soaking seeds in humic acids, the nutrients bound to these compounds can be released and absorbed more efficiently by the emerging seedlings, promoting healthy growth.
  3. Increased root development: Humic acids can stimulate root growth and development. Soaking seeds in humic acids can help initiate root elongation, increase the number of root hairs, and enhance lateral root branching. This can lead to improved nutrient and water uptake, as well as better anchorage and overall plant vigor
  4. Stress tolerance: Humic acids have been reported to enhance plant tolerance to various abiotic stresses, including drought, salinity, and heavy metal toxicity. Soaking seeds in humic acids can potentially prime the seedlings stress response mechanisms, allowing them to better withstand adverse environmental conditions.
  5. Microbial activity promotion: Humic acids can act as a food source and stimulant for beneficial soil microorganisms. Soaking seeds in humic acids can promote the growth and activity of beneficial bacteria and fungi in the rhizosphere, leading to improved nutrient cycling, disease suppression, and overall soil health.
  6. Seedling vigor and establishment: By providing a nutrient-rich and conducive environment for seed germination, humic acid seed soaking can result in stronger and more vigorous seedlings. This can lead to better establishment in the field, higher survival rates, and improved early growth stages

instructionsHtml:
Crop guidance (per label)

  • Fruit trees, olives & citrus: 1st application in pre-flowering, 2nd at fruit set, 3rd during fruit fattening.
  • Tomato: apply at each flowering interval (every 20–30 days).
  • Peppers: before pre-flowering, continuing every 20 days.
  • Leafy vegetables: apply when 2–4 true leaves are visible; repeat after 20 days.
  • Berries: in pre-flowering, repeating every 20 days.
  • Ornamentals: 2–4 treatments during the growing season.

Store between +5 °C and +40 °C. Do not mix with copper, strong acids or alkaline-reaction products. Use only in case of recognised need and do not exceed the recommended dose.

Manufactured by Arvensis Agro S.A. (Zaragoza, Spain).

shortDescription: High-potassium NK (Mg) 3-40 (2) fertiliser with boron for foliar and irrigation application — recommended to improve fruit quality and production.
descriptionHtml:
Fortik Solid is a water-soluble NK (Mg) 3-40 (2) fertiliser with boron from Arvensis Agro, designed for foliar and irrigation application. Its application is highly recommended to improve fruit development and increase production without reducing the strength of cell walls.

Potassium drives photosynthesis and the transport of sugars from leaves to fruits; because potassium programmes can induce magnesium deficiency in certain crops, Fortik Solid is further formulated with magnesium to prevent that secondary deficiency.
